# Vikas Rathore - Training Officer (COPA), Government ITI Torla, Raipur

## Summary
Vikas Rathore is a Training Officer for the COPA (Computer Operator and Programming Assistant) trade at Government ITI Torla, Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India.

## Education & Qualifications
- CITS (Craft Instructor Training Scheme) in CSA (Computer Software Applications) from NSTI (R), Hyderabad
- ITI in COPA (NCVT) from Odisha
- Diploma in Electrical Engineering from JK Institute of Engineering, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh
- NIELIT Hyderabad Certifications: O Level, CCC+, ECC, and CCC

## Industrial Experience
- 1 Year Diploma Apprenticeship Trainee (Electrical) at NTPC Ltd. (2600 MW), Korba, Chhattisgarh
- 15 Days Vocational Training at 132 KV Substation, SECL (Coal India Ltd.), Gevra, Korba, Chhattisgarh

## Technical & Programming Skills
- Languages & Development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Python, C, C++, R Programming, App Development
